descriptions.zh-Hans: 信使在阿姆斯特丹做的纸菜单，圆饼少的那一口刚好让盒子合上。
descriptions.en: My Amsterdam paper menu shows the bite that finally let the waffle box close.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 这张自制纸菜单留着糖粉里的黄油小径，只是一顿点心的记号。
descriptions.en: My homemade paper menu records the butter’s little trail through one serving of sugar.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在 NEMO 看景后自制的双圆纸签，一边用深色纸表示忘取的镜盖。
descriptions.en: My double-circle tab after NEMO uses dark paper for the lens cap I forgot to remove.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我用浅色纸边贴成的鞋尖，只记中庭光落在自己鞋上的样子。
descriptions.en: A pale paper edge on a paper shoe remembers light falling across my own toe in the Atrium.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 我自制的纸拉页可以把两只纸鞋旁的影子拉开一点。
descriptions.en: My homemade pullout moves the shadows beside two paper shoes a little apart.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 在屋顶借望远镜后做的开合卡，两片圆纸盖都能掀开，不复制博物馆产品。
descriptions.en: My flap card after borrowing binoculars on the roof has two opening paper caps; it is my own design.
